# John Carlo Santos

> Software & Systems Engineer, Chief Technology Officer at Seekers Guild, and Computer Engineering student at Bulacan State University ('28). Specializes in high-throughput data engineering, fail-closed DevSecOps guardrails, rootless container infrastructure, and autonomous AI agent harnesses. Actively open to full-time engineering, data, and DevOps roles.

## Published Technical Notes
- [Why We Run Rootless Podman Quadlets Instead of Root Docker](https://kuyacarlo.dev/notes/rootless-podman-quadlets): How declarative systemd Quadlets eliminate root daemon vulnerabilities and automate boot lifecycle.
- [Designing Offline-First Healthcare Telemetry with SQLite & Protocol Buffers](https://kuyacarlo.dev/notes/offline-first-telemetry): Vital-sign data collection, Protobuf schemas, and D2D handoffs for rural health workers in Kasigla.
- [QC for Devs & Data Pros — Your Pre-Push Safety Net](https://kuyacarlo.dev/notes/pre-push-safety): Pre-push hook checklist and fail-closed secret scanning with Bantay.
- [Building High-Performance MCP Servers with FastMCP](https://kuyacarlo.dev/notes/building-mcp-servers): Connecting LLM reasoning engines to production APIs using Model Context Protocol.

## Featured Open-Source Projects
- [ComplyAIgent](https://github.com/liitkud/complyaigent): DevSecOps policy compliance engine compiling regulatory text into fail-closed pre-push git hooks. *AMD Developer Hackathon 2026*.
- [git-profile & ssh-profile](https://github.com/kuyacarlo/git-profile): Production Go CLI suite for seamlessly switching multiple Git identities, GPG signing keys, and scoped SSH URLs per repository.
- [WorkSight](https://github.com/4sightorg/worksight): Multi-agent workplace analytics platform predicting employee burnout from enterprise metadata. *Top 3 Finalist @ BPI DataWave 2025*.
- [BetterTranspo](https://github.com/kuyacarlo): Decentralized public transit platform integrating BEEP™ card payments, LoRaWAN vehicle tracking, and passenger fullness meters. *1st Runner Up @ LPU Innoverse 2025*.
- [KLIMA](https://github.com/Signal-No-5/klima): Bronze→Silver→Gold environmental data processing pipeline delivering localized flood risk alerts for Calumpit LGU. *PJDSC 2025*.
- [SAGE](https://github.com/kuyacarlo/sage-mcp): Autonomous academic co-pilot using MCP to ingest CHED-verified university curricula into Notion. *MLH Notion MCP Challenge*.
- [Bantay](https://github.com/kuyacarlo/bantay): Two-layer pre-push git security hook pairing local pattern matching with async smartphone approvals for AI agents.
- [freestack](https://freestack.kuyacarlo.dev): Curated directory of free developer tiers, student unlocks, and startup resources with commercial notes.
- [room-tba](https://github.com/kuyacarlo/room-tba): BulSU campus room schedule and vacancy finder under the BulSUTools initiative.
- [BetterBulakan](https://github.com/kuyacarlo/betterbulakan): Community-powered municipal public utility and transparency portal for Bulakan, Bulacan.
